text:
No single product does all three well, so it depends on your devices. I'm assuming an iPhone and Apple Watch. Tell me if you use Android or a Galaxy Watch.

## Best all-in-one: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140W + Qi2)
- It has a 140W USB-C port (enough for a 16" MacBook Pro), a built-in retractable 100W cable, two more ports, and a Qi2 15W magnetic pad for your phone.
- It has no dedicated watch pad. You'd charge the watch through a spare port with its own cable (my inference from the port list).
- **Price:** $149.99 at Baseus. It was sold out on Baseus's US store when checked on Oct 21, so check stock first. Only one port reaches 140W; the others top out at 100W or less.
- [Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 on Dealectric (links to Baseus's store)](https://dealectric.com/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2)

## Best for a tidy desk: wireless stand plus a laptop hub or charger
A 3-in-1 stand handles phone, watch, and earbuds, and a separate dock handles the laptop.

**Wireless stand (pick one):**
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is WIRED's best overall. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges the Apple Watch, and has an AirPods spot. The list price is $109, and WIRED shows it around $80–98 at Belkin, Amazon, and Best Buy. It's a good fit if the stand stays on your desk. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1** is the budget pick, at about $40 (down from $80). It's Qi2 certified, 15W, and includes the charger and cable. The watch charger is a separate unit that slots into the back. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo/MagSafe 3-in-1** is sold with a 40W adapter and folds flat for travel. Prices vary by source ($89.99 list, often about $35–70 on sale), so check the current price. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/) and [The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-wireless-charging-stations-for-desk)

**Laptop side (pick one):**
- **Anker 341 USB-C Hub** is about $40 and passes through up to 100W to the laptop. [StandDeskLab](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/)
- **Belkin Connect USB-C 11-in-1 Pro GaN Dock** has 96W power delivery and drives up to three 4K displays. It's about $138 on sale (list $200). [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-laptop-docking-stations/)

## Wired-only alternative: Anker Prime 200W
It has 4 USB-C and 2 USB-A ports and 200W total. It can run a MacBook Air, iPhone, iPad, and watch with headroom, but it has no wireless pad. [The Office Journal](https://www.theofficejournal.com/guide/best-charging-stations-for-multiple-devices-desk)

## My pick
If you want one box and the Baseus is in stock, get it. If you want the cleanest setup, get the Belkin stand plus the Anker 341 hub, about $120–150 total at sale prices. Whichever you choose, check that the laptop port's wattage matches your laptop's charger.

I couldn't open the stores directly, so the links go to the review pages above. Prices there may have changed.
